integrity: Two standalone algorithms separately enumerate all vertex subsets. A complete oriented-Hasse topological sort verifies acyclicity of a matching in each stage. Finite-field homology is a cross-check; integral and homotopy conclusions use the acyclic matching.
scientific_limitations: Finite fourteen-vertex Heawood graph only; no higher-order incidence-graph generalization or equivariant statement. The independence-complex stage is prior work, not a new result. The new stages are proved by a complete executable discrete-Morse matching; independent external mathematical validation is not performed.
title: Complete integral homotopy and persistence of the Heawood forest filtration
